description: A PostHog endpoint: a named HogQL or insight query exposed as an API route (/api/projects/{project_id}/endpoints/{name}/run), optionally materialized.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the endpoint belongs to.

Name.description: Unique URL-safe name, used in the endpoint's path. Must start with a letter and contain only letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores. Changing it replaces the endpoint.

Query.description: HogQL or insight query the endpoint executes, as a JSON object with a "kind" key (use Fn::ToJsonString), e.g. {"kind": "HogQLQuery", "query": "SELECT count() FROM events"}. Changing it creates a new endpoint version.

Description.description: Human-readable description of what this endpoint returns.

DataFreshnessSeconds.description: How fresh the data should be, in seconds: 900, 1800, 3600, 21600, 43200, 86400 (the default) or 604800. Controls cache TTL and materialization sync frequency.

IsActive.description: Whether this endpoint is available for execution via the API. Defaults to true.

IsMaterialized.description: Whether query results are materialized to S3.

DerivedFromInsight.description: Short ID of the insight this endpoint was derived from.

BucketOverrides.description: Per-column bucket overrides for range variable materialization. Keys are column names, values are bucket keys.

Tags.description: Tag names associated with this endpoint.

OptionalBreakdownProperties.description: Breakdown property names that may be omitted on /run. Omitted ones return data aggregated across all values of that breakdown. By default every breakdown variable is required.

EndpointPath.description: Relative API path to execute this endpoint.

Url.description: Absolute URL to execute this endpoint.

MaterializationStatus.description: Current materialization status of the current version (e.g. Completed, Running).
